round_history.retrieved_content:
[DAY1 17:25:30 - DAY1 17:26:00]
I open the packaging, compare the pineapples, and restore the packaging. Alice: "It's still a bit prickly." Alice: "Is this one more ripe?" Alice: "I don't know either." Alice: "It's pretty green, isn't it?" I say, "This one." I put my pineapple next to Alice's for comparison; Alice picks up her chosen pineapple and says, "Hello." I walk over with them to the fruit counter and talk to the sales assistant. "Hello," I say. "Cut it, thank you," I add. "Done for the day," I say. "What time is it?" I ask.

[DAY1 17:25:00 - DAY1 17:25:30]
I walk to the counter, gesture, and see Alice holding a pineapple. I pick it up and turn the pineapple in my hands as we discuss which to choose. Tasha says, "No." I say, "Oh, just eat it ourselves," and, "Alright, let them cut it," then tell someone, "Take a close-up shot of him cutting it." Tasha says, "You can call the staff to help you cut it." I say, "Alright, cut it," and, "Pick the one with bigger grids," adding, "I can do this" and, "I cut this in Singapore." Tasha asks, "Which one do you think is better?"

[DAY1 17:24:31 - DAY1 17:25:00]
Alice: "Mango." "Pineapple," I say. Tasha: "Pineapple isn't good for desserts." Alice: "Mango." I walk further inside, put down the shopping cart, and approach a cabinet where Tasha and Alice pick through a box of fruit. "Try the dessert," I say. Alice: "Let's buy this." Alice: "This one, from their store." Alice: "That kind." Alice: "What's it called again?" "Can't we cut it fresh?" I ask. Tasha: "Actually, I think fresh cut isn't very good." Tasha: "You can buy it and have them cut it on the spot for you." "That works," I say. "But if we buy pineapple, should we put it in the dessert?" I ask. Tasha: "No."

[DAY1 18:03:00 - DAY1 18:03:26]
I look at my phone with everyone, happily chatting. Tasha: "Then let's go buy some cling film and tart shells." Katrina: "Tongue click?" Katrina: "I can't do it." I say, "Alright." Tasha: "And some mint—might not be able to find it; and that's it. Maybe milk powder too." I say, "Take another photo and manage it. Can you manage it?" Lucia: "Manage it, manage it." Shure: "Can't manage it." I say, "Manage it, okay." Shure: "How to manage it? Just make it look more like a normal human." I say, "No idea." Katrina: "Forbid it, forbid it for 10 seconds." I say, "That's tough, that's tough."

[DAY1 19:20:30 - DAY1 19:20:59]
Katrina: "Was my order delivered or shipped?" Alice: "No, no." I pour the other one into the bag. Tasha: "I picked it." Tasha: "Uh, it was shipped." I put the dirty plates on the table. Katrina: "So you bought it, right?" Katrina: "The tart crust and the taro." Tasha: "Picked it but haven't ordered yet." Katrina: "Oh, I'll send it to you." I continue tidying up. I place used toilet paper on the table and wipe food scraps off the plate with a paper towel. Tasha: "And the display stand." I take out the remaining trash and continue pouring contents into the garbage bag. "Help me with this," I say. Alice: "Help with this." "Just help me with this," I say. Tasha: "Give it a nudge." I call Alice over to help. "Yeah," I say. I ask for help scraping the scraps off the plate into the trash bag. "Okay," I say.

[DAY1 12:12:00 - DAY1 12:12:28]
I tell Shure to sit down. I remain seated and look around, noticing divorce papers. Shure: "After 5:30 PM." Shure: "Around 5:30, yeah." I see Shure writing on the whiteboard. "Big pizza," I say, and laugh. "A bow," I add as I lean back, lean forward, and rock slightly. "The first pizza is fine," I say. Shure: "BBQ." I stay seated, watching everyone.
